Do not generate replacement ablations and present them as the original study. INTERPRETATION ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Ablation evidence requires an actual implemented variant plus a corresponding historical result or preserved trained artifact. Textual mentions, proposed methodology diagrams, or parameter names alone do not establish that an ablation experiment was executed. Classifier hyperparameter variants must not be relabeled as GAN/VAE/diffusion generator ablations. SAFETY CONFIRMATION -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
